scope: Read-only production system-account and deployment observation of a pinned live NATS broker, combining declared IDZ census with VARZ/CONNZ, production-parsed static source digest, connected principals and bounded kubectl transport fixtures. Broker-assigned client IDs bind system and ordinary queue connections to their actual accounts; the deployment case refuses an authority-account queue client and authority Secret rotation. A kubectl shim does not establish live Kubernetes RBAC denials, exhaustive custody or distributed activation.
